subject: ddl: refine range validation after scaning regions (#59767)
summary: Tightens `loadTableRanges`/`validateAndFillRanges` to fail fast when PD-scan results don’t cover the requested `startKey` (e.g. leaderless region filtered out), preventing silent backfill-range skips; classifies `mysql.ErrInvalidSplitRegionRanges` as reorg-retryable so add-index can recover instead of rollback. No remaining Blocker/High issues found, and the touched validation/retry logic shows no later upstream/master follow-up fixes.
